ex.en: Never have I seen such a big whale.
ex.zh: 我從沒看過那麼大的鯨魚。

ex.en: Whales are said to have lived on land long ago.
ex.zh: 據說鯨魚很久以前是住在陸地上的。

ex.en: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
ex.zh: 一隻受傷的鯨魚被沖上了海灘。

whale.en: a very large sea animal that breathes air and looks like a huge fish

ex.en: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
ex.zh: 走廊必須夠寬，讓輪椅能通過。

ex.en: The building isn't yet up to code because it still needs a wheelchair ramp.
ex.zh: 這棟建築還不符合法規，因為仍缺少輪椅坡道。

wheelchair.en: a chair with wheels for people who cannot walk

ex.en: We buy at wholesale prices.
ex.zh: 我們以批發價購買。

ex.en: The wholesale market opens at 4 a.m.
ex.zh: 批發市場凌晨四點開門。

wholesale.en: relating to selling goods in large amounts at lower prices, usually to shops

ex.en: We sell wholesale to restaurants.
ex.zh: 我們以批發方式賣給餐廳。

ex.en: These goods are only sold wholesale.
ex.zh: 這些商品只批發不零售。

wholesale.en: in large amounts at lower prices, usually to shops

ex.en: The company made wholesale changes to its management.
ex.zh: 公司對管理層進行了全面改組。

ex.en: Wholesale job cuts are expected.
ex.zh: 預計會有大規模裁員。

wholesale.en: affecting a very large number of things or the whole of something

whereby.zh: 藉此、憑此（引導說明方式的子句）

ex.en: We set up a system whereby customers can track their orders online.
ex.zh: 我們建立了一套系統，讓客戶可以在網路上追蹤訂單。

ex.en: The company introduced a plan whereby staff can work from home twice a week.
ex.zh: 公司推出一項方案，讓員工每週可以在家工作兩天。

whereby.en: used to say by which method or rule something is done

ex.en: Her words were wholly void of meaning.
ex.zh: 她的話完全沒有意義。

ex.en: I'm not wholly convinced by his explanation.
ex.zh: 我並沒有完全被他的解釋說服。

ex.en: The company is wholly owned by a Japanese firm.
ex.zh: 這家公司由一家日本企業百分之百持有。

ex.en: Flour is made from wheat.
ex.zh: 麵粉是用小麥做的。

ex.en: Can you tell wheat from barley?
ex.zh: 你分得出小麥和大麥嗎？

wheat.en: a plant whose grain is used to make flour and bread

ex.en: We buy our products from a wholesaler.
ex.zh: 我們向批發商進貨。

ex.en: The wholesaler offers discounts on bulk orders.
ex.zh: 這家批發商對大量訂購提供折扣。

wholesaler.en: a person or company that sells goods in large amounts to shops

ex.en: We were just talking about you when you called.
ex.zh: 你打電話來的時候，我們正好在聊你。

ex.en: Life begins when we realize who we really are.
ex.zh: 當我們明白自己真正是誰時，人生才開始。

when.en: at the time that something happens

ex.en: When does the store open?
ex.zh: 這家店什麼時候開門？

ex.en: When is your flight?
ex.zh: 你的班機是什麼時候？

when.en: used to ask at what time something happens

ex.en: The day will come when you will realize it.
ex.zh: 總有一天你會明白的。

ex.en: I remember the day when we first met.
ex.zh: 我記得我們第一次見面的那天。

when.en: used to say the time at which something happens

ex.en: What did you say?
ex.zh: 你說什麼？

ex.en: What's the problem?
ex.zh: 有什麼問題嗎？

what.en: used to ask about a thing or fact you do not know

ex.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?
ex.zh: 你覺得他會對什麼主題感興趣？

ex.en: What time does the meeting start?
ex.zh: 會議幾點開始？

what.en: used before a noun to ask which one or which kind

ex.en: What you say is quite wide of the mark.
ex.zh: 你說的完全離題了。

ex.en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
ex.zh: 你的所作所為讓全班蒙羞。

ex.en: What a beautiful day!
ex.zh: 天氣真好！

ex.en: What a great idea!
ex.zh: 真是個好主意！

what.en: used before a noun phrase to show strong feeling, such as surprise

ex.en: Where are you going to go on your vacation?
ex.zh: 你放假打算去哪裡玩？

ex.en: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
ex.zh: 請告訴我們哪裡有雜貨店。

where.en: used to ask about a place or direction

ex.en: This is where I was born and brought up.
ex.zh: 這裡就是我出生長大的地方。

ex.en: This is the village where the poet was born.
ex.zh: 這是那位詩人出生的村莊。

where.en: in or to the place in which something happens

ex.en: I have no idea why she got so angry.
ex.zh: 我不知道她為什麼那麼生氣。

ex.en: Why are there no taxis at the station today?
ex.zh: 為什麼今天車站沒有計程車？

ex.en: Why on earth did you sell your newly-built house?
ex.zh: 你到底為什麼要把新蓋的房子賣掉？

why.en: used to ask or talk about the reason for something

why.zh: why don't you / why don't we：何不…（提出建議）

ex.en: Why don't you take a break?
ex.zh: 你何不休息一下？

ex.en: Why don't we meet tomorrow?
ex.zh: 我們明天見面怎麼樣？

why.en: used to suggest that someone does something

ex.en: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.
ex.zh: 我在洗澡的時候電話響了。

ex.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
ex.zh: 我不在的時候，他會代理我的職務。

ex.en: Don't use your phone while driving.
ex.zh: 開車時不要用手機。

while.en: during the time that something else is happening

ex.en: While I like the design, the price is too high.
ex.zh: 雖然我喜歡這個設計，但價格太高了。

ex.en: Some people like tea, while others prefer coffee.
ex.zh: 有些人喜歡茶，有些人則偏好咖啡。

while.en: used to show that two things are different or that one is true although the other is

ex.en: After a while, the man came into the room.
ex.zh: 過了一會兒，那個人走進了房間。

ex.en: I haven't seen him for a while.
ex.zh: 我有一陣子沒見到他了。

while.en: a period of time, usually fairly short

ex.en: I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
ex.zh: 我花了一整天看這本小說。

ex.en: The whole audience got up and started to applaud.
ex.zh: 全場觀眾都站起來鼓掌。

ex.en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
ex.zh: 你的所作所為讓全班都丟臉。

whole.en: complete, with no part left out

whole.zh: on the whole / as a whole：整體來說

ex.en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
ex.zh: 整體來說，我對結果很滿意。

ex.en: As a whole, the plan seems to be good.
ex.zh: 整體來看，這個計畫似乎不錯。

whole.en: considering everything, or all parts together

ex.en: We have three dogs, one white and two black.
ex.zh: 我們有三隻狗，一隻白的、兩隻黑的。

ex.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看到一朵白雲飄過天空。

ex.en: Her skin is whiter than snow.
ex.zh: 她的皮膚比雪還白。

white.en: having the color of snow or milk

ex.en: Put them on the baking pan and smear them with egg whites.
ex.zh: 把它們放在烤盤上，再塗上蛋白。

ex.en: She was dressed in white.
ex.zh: 她穿著一身白。

white.en: the color of snow, or the clear part of an egg that turns this color when cooked

ex.en: The wheel began to roll slowly.
ex.zh: 輪子開始慢慢轉動。

ex.en: Cars have four wheels.
ex.zh: 汽車有四個輪子。

wheel.en: a round object that turns to help a vehicle or machine move

wheel.zh: 方向盤（at the wheel：開車、掌舵）

ex.en: Japanese cars' steering wheels are on the right.
ex.zh: 日本車的方向盤在右邊。

ex.en: Tom fell asleep at the wheel.
ex.zh: 湯姆開車時睡著了。

wheel.en: the round part that a driver turns to steer a vehicle

ex.en: The nurse wheeled the patient into the room.
ex.zh: 護理師把病人推進病房。

ex.en: He wheeled his bike across the street.
ex.zh: 他牽著腳踏車過馬路。

wheel.en: to push a cart, bed or chair that rolls along the ground

ex.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
ex.zh: 每次聽到那首歌，我就會想起年輕的時候。

ex.en: Whenever I have a question, I just Google it.
ex.zh: 我一有問題就上 Google 查。

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so we can eat whenever we want.
ex.zh: 晚餐準備好了，我們想什麼時候吃都可以。

ex.en: Call me whenever you need help.
ex.zh: 需要幫忙隨時打給我。

whenever.en: at any time that you choose or that happens

ex.en: Tom whispered something to Mary and she smiled.
ex.zh: 湯姆小聲對瑪麗說了些什麼，她笑了。

ex.en: What did she whisper to you?
ex.zh: 她跟你說了什麼悄悄話？

ex.en: Let me whisper in your ear.
ex.zh: 我在你耳邊小聲說。

whisper.en: to speak very quietly so that only a person near you can hear

ex.en: She spoke in a whisper so she wouldn't wake the baby.
ex.zh: 她小聲說話，以免吵醒寶寶。

ex.en: I heard a whisper behind me.
ex.zh: 我聽到身後有人在低語。

whisper.en: a very quiet way of speaking, using your breath rather than your voice

wherever.zh: 無論在哪裡、在任何……的地方

ex.en: In Netherlands you can see windmills wherever you go.
ex.zh: 在荷蘭，無論走到哪裡都看得到風車。

ex.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
ex.zh: 湯姆無論去哪裡都帶著相機。

ex.en: Fred followed my mother wherever she went.
ex.zh: 我母親走到哪裡，弗雷德就跟到哪裡。

wherever.en: in any place, or in every place that

whim.zh: 突然的念頭、一時的興致

ex.en: On a whim, we decided to drive to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們一時興起，決定開車去海邊。

ex.en: He bought the car on a whim.
ex.zh: 他一時興起就買下了那輛車。

whim.en: a sudden wish to do or have something, often without a good reason

ex.en: Tom can't account for his whereabouts on the day that Mary was murdered.
ex.zh: 湯姆無法交代瑪麗遇害那天他人在哪裡。

ex.en: The police are asking about the missing girl's whereabouts.
ex.zh: 警方正在打聽失蹤女孩的下落。

ex.en: His family has no idea of his current whereabouts.
ex.zh: 他的家人完全不知道他現在的行蹤。

whereabouts.en: the place where a person or thing is

ex.en: Please write the agenda on the whiteboard.
ex.zh: 請把議程寫在白板上。

ex.en: We reviewed the sales plan on the whiteboard.
ex.zh: 我們在白板上檢視了銷售計畫。

whiteboard.en: a smooth white board that you write on with special pens

ex.en: The cargo was unloaded at the wharf.
ex.zh: 貨物在碼頭卸下。

ex.en: A small warehouse stands beside the wharf.
ex.zh: 碼頭旁有一間小型倉庫。

wharf.en: a flat structure beside the water where ships stop to load and unload

ex.en: My brother loves sports, whereas I prefer reading.
ex.zh: 我哥哥愛運動，而我比較喜歡閱讀。

ex.en: Summers are hot here, whereas winters are mild.
ex.zh: 這裡夏天很熱，而冬天很溫和。

ex.en: He poured a small glass of whisky after dinner.
ex.zh: 他晚餐後倒了一小杯威士忌。

ex.en: This whisky is made in Scotland and aged for ten years.
ex.zh: 這款威士忌產自蘇格蘭，陳年十年。

ex.en: The rider held a whip in one hand and the reins in the other.
ex.zh: 騎士一手拿著鞭子，一手握著韁繩。

ex.en: The sound of the whip made the horse run faster.
ex.zh: 鞭子的聲音讓馬跑得更快。

ex.en: Whip the cream until it becomes thick and fluffy.
ex.zh: 把鮮奶油打到濃稠蓬鬆為止。

ex.en: She whipped the egg whites and folded them into the batter.
ex.zh: 她把蛋白打發，再拌進麵糊裡。

ex.en: The strong wind whipped the rain against the windows.
ex.zh: 強風把雨狠狠地抽打在窗戶上。

ex.en: He whipped the horse to make it go faster.
ex.zh: 他鞭打那匹馬，想讓牠跑快一點。

ex.en: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
ex.zh: 你比較喜歡哪個，茶還是咖啡？

ex.en: Which of these bags is yours?
ex.zh: 這些袋子裡哪一個是你的？

which.zh: （關係代名詞）指前面提到的事物

ex.en: This is the book which I told you about.
ex.zh: 這就是我跟你說過的那本書。

ex.en: He lost his phone, which made him very upset.
ex.zh: 他弄丟了手機，這讓他非常沮喪。

ex.en: Who is knocking on the door?
ex.zh: 是誰在敲門？

ex.en: I don't know who left this bag here.
ex.zh: 我不知道是誰把這個袋子留在這裡的。

who.zh: …的人（關係代名詞，如 the man who called）

ex.en: The woman who lives next door is a nurse.
ex.zh: 住在隔壁的那位女士是護理師。

ex.en: I have a friend who plays the violin very well.
ex.zh: 我有個朋友小提琴拉得很好。

whether.zh: 是否、要不要（I don't know whether...）

ex.en: I don't know whether he will come to the party.
ex.zh: 我不知道他會不會來參加派對。

ex.en: She asked whether the store was open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 她問這家店星期天有沒有營業。

ex.en: We will go camping whether it rains or not.
ex.zh: 不管會不會下雨，我們都要去露營。

ex.en: Whether you agree or not, I'm going to try it.
ex.zh: 不管你同不同意，我都要試試看。

ex.en: Whose umbrella is this on the chair?
ex.zh: 椅子上這把雨傘是誰的？

ex.en: I wonder whose idea it was to come here.
ex.zh: 我在想來這裡是誰出的主意。

ex.en: He is the man whose car was stolen last week.
ex.zh: 他就是上星期車子被偷的那個人。

ex.en: You can order whatever you like on the menu.
ex.zh: 菜單上你喜歡什麼都可以點。

ex.en: Whatever happens, I will always support you.
ex.zh: 無論發生什麼事，我都會支持你。

ex.en: "Do you want pizza or noodles?" "Whatever, I don't mind."
ex.zh: 「你要吃披薩還是麵？」「隨便啦，我都可以。」

ex.en: Whatever, it doesn't matter to me.
ex.zh: 隨便啦，我無所謂。

whom.zh: 誰（受格）；…的人（關係代名詞受格）

ex.en: To whom should I send this letter?
ex.zh: 這封信我該寄給誰？

ex.en: The woman whom I met yesterday is a doctor.
ex.zh: 我昨天遇到的那位女士是醫生。

ex.en: He is the friend with whom I traveled to Japan.
ex.zh: 他就是和我一起去日本旅行的朋友。

ex.en: Please keep your seat belt fastened whilst the plane is moving.
ex.zh: 飛機移動期間請繫好安全帶。

ex.en: He read the newspaper whilst waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 他等公車時看了報紙。

ex.en: Some students prefer maths, whilst others like history better.
ex.zh: 有些學生比較喜歡數學，而其他學生則更愛歷史。

ex.en: The first plan is cheap, whilst the second one is far more expensive.
ex.zh: 第一個方案很便宜，然而第二個貴得多。

ex.en: Whoever finishes first can help the others.
ex.zh: 無論誰先做完，都可以去幫助其他人。

ex.en: You can invite whoever you like to the party.
ex.zh: 你可以邀請任何你想邀請的人來派對。

ex.en: Whoever left the window open should close it.
ex.zh: 不管是誰把窗戶開著，都該把它關上。

ex.en: I have no interest whatsoever in joining that club.
ex.zh: 我對加入那個社團一點興趣也沒有。

ex.en: There was no evidence whatsoever to support his story.
ex.zh: 完全沒有任何證據可以支持他的說法。

ex.en: You may do whatsoever you wish with this gift.
ex.zh: 這份禮物你想怎麼處理都可以。

ex.en: He gave up everything whatsoever that he owned to help the village.
ex.zh: 他把自己所擁有的一切都拿出來幫助村子。

ex.en: You can take whichever you like best.
ex.zh: 你可以拿你最喜歡的任何一個。

ex.en: Whichever you choose, I will be happy with it.
ex.zh: 無論你選哪一個，我都會很滿意。

whitehall.zh: 白廳（倫敦街道；英國政府的代稱）

ex.en: Whitehall is a street in London that has many government offices.
ex.zh: 白廳是倫敦的一條街，上面有許多政府機關。

ex.en: People often use Whitehall to mean the British civil service.
ex.zh: 人們常用「白廳」來指稱英國的文官體系。

ex.en: We walked along Whitehall on our way to Parliament Square.
ex.zh: 我們沿著白廳走向國會廣場。

ex.en: Use a whisk to mix the eggs and milk.
ex.zh: 用打蛋器把蛋和牛奶攪拌均勻。

ex.en: I bought a small whisk for making pancake batter.
ex.zh: 我買了一支小打蛋器來調鬆餅麵糊。

ex.en: Whisk the eggs until they become light and fluffy.
ex.zh: 把蛋打到變得輕盈蓬鬆。

ex.en: The waiter whisked away our empty plates.
ex.zh: 服務生很快地收走了我們的空盤子。

ex.en: The referee blew his whistle to stop the game.
ex.zh: 裁判吹哨讓比賽暫停。

ex.en: We heard the whistle of the train in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們聽到遠處火車的汽笛聲。

ex.en: He whistled happily as he walked to work.
ex.zh: 他開心地吹著口哨走去上班。

ex.en: Can you whistle your favorite song for me?
ex.zh: 你可以吹你最愛的歌給我聽嗎？

ex.en: He poured a small glass of whiskey and sat by the fire.
ex.zh: 他倒了一小杯威士忌，坐到火爐旁。

ex.en: This whiskey is aged in wooden barrels for ten years.
ex.zh: 這種威士忌在木桶裡陳放了十年。

ex.en: Whoa, that was a huge fish!
ex.zh: 哇，那條魚好大！

ex.en: Whoa, look at the size of that cake!
ex.zh: 哇，看看那個蛋糕有多大！

ex.en: Whoa, slow down. I can't follow you.
ex.zh: 等等，慢一點，我跟不上你。

ex.en: Whoa, let's think about this before we decide.
ex.zh: 慢著，我們先想一想再決定。

ex.en: Stop whining and start working on the problem.
ex.zh: 別再發牢騷了，開始處理問題吧。

ex.en: The children whined about having to go to bed early.
ex.zh: 孩子們哭哭啼啼地抱怨得早睡。

ex.en: The puppy whined at the door to go outside.
ex.zh: 小狗在門邊嗚嗚叫著想出去。

ex.en: Our dog whines whenever we leave the house.
ex.zh: 每次我們出門，我們的狗都會哀叫。

ex.en: We heard a low whine from the corner of the room.
ex.zh: 我們聽到房間角落傳來低低的嗚嗚聲。

ex.en: The whine of the engine grew louder.
ex.zh: 引擎的尖嘯聲越來越大。

ex.en: Leaves whirled in the wind.
ex.zh: 樹葉在風中旋轉飛舞。

ex.en: The dancers whirled around the floor.
ex.zh: 舞者們在舞池裡旋轉。

ex.en: She spent a whirl of days preparing for the trip.
ex.zh: 她花了忙亂的幾天來準備這趟旅行。

ex.en: The dancers moved in a whirl of color.
ex.zh: 舞者們在一片旋轉的色彩中舞動。

ex.en: He whacked the ball over the fence.
ex.zh: 他一棒把球打過了圍籬。

ex.en: Don't whack the table so hard.
ex.zh: 別那麼用力拍桌子。

ex.en: The branch fell with a loud whack.
ex.zh: 樹枝砰的一聲掉了下來。

ex.en: He gave the old TV a whack and it started working.
ex.zh: 他拍了老電視一下，它就恢復運作了。

ex.en: She told a joke, whereupon everyone burst out laughing.
ex.zh: 她講了個笑話，於是大家都笑了出來。

ex.en: He opened the door, whereupon the dog ran outside.
ex.zh: 他一打開門，狗就跑了出去。

ex.en: The cat's whiskers twitched when it heard a noise.
ex.zh: 貓聽到聲音時鬍鬚抖了一下。

ex.en: He shaved off every whisker before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前他把每根鬍鬚都刮乾淨了。

ex.en: This is the room wherein the document was signed.
ex.zh: 這是簽署那份文件的房間。

ex.en: He wrote a letter wherein he explained his decision.
ex.zh: 他寫了一封信，在信中說明了他的決定。

ex.en: I caught a whiff of fresh bread from the bakery.
ex.zh: 我從麵包店聞到一陣新鮮麵包的香味。

ex.en: There was a whiff of smoke in the air.
ex.zh: 空氣中有一絲煙味。

ex.en: A whirlwind picked up leaves and dust in the yard.
ex.zh: 一陣旋風捲起院子裡的落葉和灰塵。

ex.en: The couple had a whirlwind romance and married in three months.
ex.zh: 這對情侶閃電戀愛，三個月就結婚了。

ex.en: She topped the pie with whipped cream.
ex.zh: 她在派上擠了打發鮮奶油。

ex.en: The dessert came with a spoonful of whipped butter.
ex.zh: 這道甜點附了一匙打發的奶油。

whipped.zh: 攪打；鞭打（whip 的過去式）

ex.en: He whipped the egg whites until they were stiff.
ex.zh: 他把蛋白打到硬挺。

ex.en: The wind whipped the flags back and forth.
ex.zh: 風把旗子吹得來回飛舞。

ex.en: The whiteness of the snow hurt my eyes in the sun.
ex.zh: 陽光下雪的一片潔白讓我的眼睛很刺痛。

ex.en: She admired the whiteness of the freshly washed sheets.
ex.zh: 她欣賞剛洗好的床單那種潔白。

ex.en: The whiteness of his face showed how scared he was.
ex.zh: 他臉色蒼白，顯示他有多害怕。

ex.en: Illness had left a strange whiteness in her cheeks.
ex.zh: 生病讓她的雙頰變得蒼白。

ex.en: He won a whopping ten thousand dollars in the lottery.
ex.zh: 他中了驚人的一萬元樂透。

ex.en: That was a whopping lie, and everyone knew it.
ex.zh: 那是個天大的謊話，每個人都知道。

ex.en: They caught a whopping big fish at the lake.
ex.zh: 他們在湖裡釣到一條超大的魚。

ex.en: It was a whopping great party that lasted all night.
ex.zh: 那是一場盛大的派對，持續了一整晚。

ex.en: This recipe uses wholemeal instead of white flour.
ex.zh: 這個食譜用全麥麵粉代替白麵粉。

ex.en: She baked a loaf of bread with wholemeal and seeds.
ex.zh: 她用全麥麵粉和種子烤了一條麵包。

ex.en: A wholesome breakfast includes fruit and whole grains.
ex.zh: 健康的早餐包括水果和全穀類。

ex.en: She wants her kids to grow up in a wholesome environment.
ex.zh: 她希望孩子在健康的環境中長大。

ex.en: It was a wholesome movie that the whole family enjoyed.
ex.zh: 那是一部全家人都喜歡的溫馨正向電影。

ex.en: He has a wholesome, friendly smile that puts people at ease.
ex.zh: 他有著讓人安心的親切笑容。

whimsical.zh: 異想天開的；古怪有趣的

ex.en: The cafe has a whimsical design with colorful chairs.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡館有著異想天開的設計，擺著五顏六色的椅子。

ex.en: She told a whimsical story about a dancing cat.
ex.zh: 她說了一個關於跳舞貓咪的奇想故事。

ex.en: Whaling was once a major industry in coastal towns.
ex.zh: 捕鯨曾是沿海城鎮的一大產業。

ex.en: Many countries have banned commercial whaling.
ex.zh: 許多國家已禁止商業捕鯨。

ex.en: The Whigs were a political party in Britain in the 1700s and 1800s.
ex.zh: 輝格黨是英國十八、十九世紀的一個政黨。

ex.en: Historians study how the Whig party changed over time.
ex.zh: 歷史學家研究輝格黨如何隨時間演變。

ex.en: I wholeheartedly agree with your idea.
ex.zh: 我全心全意同意你的想法。

ex.en: She threw herself wholeheartedly into the new project.
ex.zh: 她全心投入這個新專案。

ex.en: The puppy began to whimper when we left the room.
ex.zh: 我們離開房間時，小狗開始嗚咽。

ex.en: The child whimpered quietly in the dark.
ex.zh: 孩子在黑暗中輕聲啜泣。

ex.en: We heard a faint whimper from under the bed.
ex.zh: 我們聽到床底下傳來微弱的嗚咽聲。

ex.en: He gave up without even a whimper.
ex.zh: 他連一聲哀號都沒有就放棄了。

ex.en: He returned to the village whence he had come.
ex.zh: 他回到了他原本來的那座村莊。

ex.en: Nobody knew whence the strange sound came.
ex.zh: 沒有人知道那奇怪的聲音從何而來。

ex.en: He wheezed as he climbed the stairs.
ex.zh: 他爬樓梯時氣喘吁吁。

ex.en: The old man wheezed a reply.
ex.zh: 老先生喘著氣回答。

ex.en: I could hear a wheeze in his chest.
ex.zh: 我聽得到他胸口發出的喘鳴聲。

ex.en: The cold left her with a nasty wheeze.
ex.zh: 這次感冒讓她喘得很厲害。

ex.en: We saw a whitetail grazing at the edge of the forest.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻白尾鹿在森林邊緣吃草。

ex.en: The whitetail raised its tail and ran away.
ex.zh: 那隻白尾鹿豎起尾巴跑掉了。

ex.en: He sat on the porch and whittled a small bird from a piece of wood.
ex.zh: 他坐在門廊上，用一塊木頭削出一隻小鳥。

ex.en: Grandpa likes to whittle sticks while he tells stories.
ex.zh: 爺爺喜歡一邊說故事一邊削木棍。

ex.en: The team whittled the list down to five names.
ex.zh: 團隊把名單逐步刪減到五個名字。

ex.en: Rising prices have whittled away our savings.
ex.zh: 物價上漲讓我們的存款逐漸減少。

ex.en: You can invite whomever you like to the party.
ex.zh: 你可以邀請任何你想邀請的人來派對。

ex.en: Give the prize to whomever the judges choose.
ex.zh: 把獎品頒給評審選出的人。

ex.en: The small boat was pulled into a whirlpool.
ex.zh: 那艘小船被捲進了漩渦。

ex.en: Be careful swimming near the whirlpool at the bottom of the falls.
ex.zh: 在瀑布底部的漩渦附近游泳要小心。

ex.en: He pushed a wheelbarrow full of soil across the garden.
ex.zh: 他推著一車泥土穿過花園。

ex.en: We used a wheelbarrow to carry the bricks.
ex.zh: 我們用手推車搬運磚塊。

ex.en: Meditation gave her a sense of wholeness.
ex.zh: 冥想讓她有一種完整的感覺。

ex.en: The wholeness of the painting comes from its balanced colors.
ex.zh: 這幅畫的完整感來自平衡的色彩。

ex.en: My sister is a math whiz and always wins the class contest.
ex.zh: 我姐姐是數學高手，總是贏得班上的比賽。

ex.en: He is a computer whiz who fixes everyone's laptops.
ex.zh: 他是電腦高手，大家的筆電都找他修。

ex.en: The kids whooped with joy when they saw the snow.
ex.zh: 孩子們看到雪時開心地大叫。

ex.en: The crowd whooped and clapped after the final goal.
ex.zh: 最後一球進了之後，群眾歡呼鼓掌。

ex.en: He let out a whoop of delight when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到消息時高興地大叫了一聲。

ex.en: A loud whoop came from the back of the room.
ex.zh: 房間後方傳來一聲響亮的歡呼。

ex.en: Cars whizzed past us on the highway.
ex.zh: 車子在高速公路上從我們身旁呼嘯而過。

ex.en: A bullet whizzed over his head in the movie.
ex.zh: 電影中一顆子彈從他頭頂呼嘯而過。

ex.en: My brother is a whizz at math.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是數學高手。

ex.en: There was a whizz as the rocket shot up.
ex.zh: 火箭升空時發出颼的一聲。

whistling.zh: 吹口哨（whistle 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He walked down the street whistling a happy tune.
ex.zh: 他吹著輕快的口哨走在街上。

ex.en: The kettle is whistling, so the water must be ready.
ex.zh: 水壺在鳴笛，水一定燒開了。

ex.en: I could hear whistling coming from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我聽見廚房傳來口哨聲。

ex.en: The whistling of the wind kept me awake all night.
ex.zh: 風的呼嘯聲讓我整晚睡不著。

ex.en: I heard the whir of the fan above my head.
ex.zh: 我聽見頭頂風扇的呼呼聲。

ex.en: The camera made a soft whir as it took the photo.
ex.zh: 相機拍照時發出輕微的嗡嗡聲。

ex.en: The machine whirred quietly in the corner.
ex.zh: 機器在角落裡安靜地嗡嗡運轉。

ex.en: Helicopter blades whirred overhead.
ex.zh: 直升機的旋翼在頭頂呼呼作響。

ex.en: The trailer was meant to whet viewers' appetite for the film.
ex.zh: 預告片是為了引起觀眾對這部電影的興趣。

ex.en: A small snack will whet your appetite before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐前吃點小點心會讓你更有食慾。

ex.en: He whetted the knife on a stone.
ex.zh: 他在磨刀石上把刀磨利。

ex.en: The farmer whets his tools before the harvest.
ex.zh: 農夫在收成前把工具磨利。

ex.en: The door closed with a loud wham.
ex.zh: 門砰的一聲重重關上。

ex.en: There was a wham as the ball hit the wall.
ex.zh: 球撞上牆壁，發出砰的一聲。

ex.en: She whispered a secret in my ear.
ex.zh: 她在我耳邊小聲說了一個祕密。

ex.en: "Be quiet," he whispered, "the baby is asleep."
ex.zh: 「小聲點，」他低聲說，「寶寶睡著了。」

ex.en: She lacked the wherewithal to start her own business.
ex.zh: 她沒有足夠的資金自己創業。

ex.en: Not every school has the wherewithal to buy new computers.
ex.zh: 不是每所學校都有錢買新電腦。

ex.en: They painted the old fence with whitewash.
ex.zh: 他們用白色塗料粉刷舊籬笆。

ex.en: The report was a whitewash that hid the real problems.
ex.zh: 那份報告是在粉飾太平，掩蓋了真正的問題。

ex.en: We will whitewash the walls before summer.
ex.zh: 我們會在夏天前把牆刷白。

ex.en: The company tried to whitewash its mistakes.
ex.zh: 公司試圖粉飾自己的錯誤。

ex.en: She bought the hat on a whim and with a touch of whimsy.
ex.zh: 她一時興起買了那頂帽子，帶點異想天開的趣味。

ex.en: The cafe is decorated with charm and whimsy.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡廳的裝潢充滿魅力和奇趣。

ex.en: I don't care a whit what they think.
ex.zh: 我一點也不在乎他們怎麼想。

ex.en: He is not one whit better than before.
ex.zh: 他一點也沒有比以前更好。

ex.en: He gave the project his wholehearted support.
ex.zh: 他全心全意支持這個計畫。

ex.en: We offer you our wholehearted thanks for your help.
ex.zh: 我們由衷感謝你的幫忙。

ex.en: This toothpaste claims to whiten your teeth in two weeks.
ex.zh: 這款牙膏宣稱能在兩週內讓牙齒變白。

ex.en: You can whiten old sheets by soaking them in lemon juice.
ex.zh: 你可以把舊床單泡在檸檬汁裡讓它變白。

ex.en: His hair began to whiten when he was only thirty.
ex.zh: 他才三十歲，頭髮就開始變白了。

ex.en: The sky started to whiten just before dawn.
ex.zh: 黎明前，天空開始泛白。

whining.zh: 發牢騷；哀號（whine 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Stop whining and start cleaning your room.
ex.zh: 不要再抱怨了，開始整理你的房間。

ex.en: The dog was whining at the door to go out.
ex.zh: 狗在門邊哀鳴著想出去。

ex.en: She displayed her small glass animals on a whatnot in the corner.
ex.zh: 她把小玻璃動物擺在角落的多層小架子上。

ex.en: The antique whatnot had four wooden shelves.
ex.zh: 那座古董小架子有四層木板。

whitewashed.zh: 粉刷；粉飾（whitewash 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: They whitewashed the walls of the old farmhouse.
ex.zh: 他們把老農舍的牆壁刷成白色。

ex.en: The report whitewashed the company's mistakes.
ex.zh: 那份報告粉飾了公司的錯誤。

ex.en: The train whooshed past the platform.
ex.zh: 火車呼嘯著駛過月台。

ex.en: Cars whoosh by on the highway all night.
ex.zh: 整晚都有車子在公路上呼嘯而過。

ex.en: The door closed with a whoosh of air.
ex.zh: 門隨著一陣呼的風聲關上了。

ex.en: I heard the whoosh of a bike passing by.
ex.zh: 我聽見一輛腳踏車呼地經過。
